text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't take 1st place, but...
ain't it good enough anyway?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time, it'd be great if I could run
a bit less lamely, though."
choice_data_list: You were plenty cool out there!
You were plenty cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, cut that out.
Flattery is just annoying..."
choice_data_list: I'm not flattering you! The way you ran that race and—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh! Aaaah!
I don't need a monologue! You're being way too suffocating!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... So basically, you thought it was cool
is what you're saying... Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Not that I care about your opinion, but still.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Knew it, 1st place is just the coolest.
No way I'm gonna end this as a loser.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Telling me it's "up to me" doesn't help at all.
I have no idea what it takes to win in the first place.
choice_data_list: That's what trainers are there for.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That confidence is insane. Are you seriously saying that?
choice_data_list: I'll give it my all to win

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...You said it, right? Then you'd better make me win!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna stop sulking, too.
That's what you mean by "it's up to me", right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That smug face is so annoying...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fine, whatever...
I'm not losing next time, so make it tough on me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: When I say I'm gonna do it, I do it.
